test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Last month tomatoes were quite __cheap__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Costly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cheap"** means something that is low in price or cost. (सस्ता)

 
 
• **Example:** The grocery store sells **cheap **fruits and vegetables that are affordable for everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Costly"** refers to something that is high in price or expensive. (महंगा)
 
 
• **Example:** The designer handbag was too **costly **for her to afford.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cheap'** is **'costly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Insufficient** (अपर्याप्त): Not enough; inadequate.

 
 
• **Example:** The water supply was **insufficient **for the growing population.
 
 
 
• **Inexpensive** (सस्ता): Low in price; not costly.
 
 
• **Example:** She found an **inexpensive **hotel for her trip.
 
 
 
• **Less** (कम): A smaller amount or quantity.
 
 
• **Example:** He spends **less **time on social media these days.
